title: Washington National Guard airmen help fight Sheep Creek Fire
description: Washington National Guard airmen from the 141st Air Refueling Wing based at Fairchild Air Force Base, conduct mop up procedures on the Sheep Creek Fire near Northport, Wash., Aug. 6, 2018. Mop up is a wild land firefighting term for making a fire safe, or to reduce residual smoke by extinguishing or removing burning material near control lines. The 141st was called into state active duty to assist Wash. Department of Natural Resources after Governor Jay Inslee issued an emergency proclamation on July 31.

dirt, it's just it becomes part of you and you just go for it and you know
anytime you see something burning up, flaring up, you know you have to run to go
put out a spot fire, it could be exciting at times. Adventure, you know come out here
have a good time, meet some good people and fight some fire, you know if you want
to give back to the community, if you want to you know going to adventure goes
some places you haven't seen before and learn a new skill that you otherwise
wouldn't normally learn, it's a good way to give back, it's a good way to get out.
